name: The caller's notifications
description: The feed behind the bell and the notifications page: newest first, optionally one `category`, only `unread=true`, only items created after `since` (what the bell polls with), keyset-paged on (created_at, id) exactly as GET /v1/me/matches is, so a page boundary is total even when one clock statement wrote many rows in one instant. `limit` defaults to 25 and is clamped to 1..100 in the statement. `unread` is the count across EVERY category whatever the filters say, because it is the number on the bell and the bell has no filter. A private route of its own, never a parameter on a public one. Nothing here filters by the settings: a writer never inserts what the settings skip, so the feed shows what was said, and a category turned back on does not surface what was skipped while it was off. An unknown category is a 400 naming the known ones rather than an empty page, because an empty page is also what a real category with nothing in it looks like.

input.query: WITH me AS ( SELECT ls.user_id FROM live_sessions ls WHERE ls.sid = ($2)::uuid AND ls.user_id = ($1)::uuid ), lim AS ( SELECT least(greatest(($7)::int, 1), 100) AS n ), feed AS NOT MATERIALIZED ( SELECT n.* FROM notifications n JOIN me ON n.user_id = me.user_id WHERE (($3)::text IS NULL OR n.category = ($3)::text) AND (($4)::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' OR n.read_at IS NULL) AND (($5)::timestamptz IS NULL OR n.created_at > ($5)::timestamptz) ), page AS ( SELECT * FROM feed WHERE ($6)::text IS NULL OR (created_at, id) < (split_part(($6)::text, '|', 1)::timestamptz, split_part(($6)::text, '|', 2)::uuid) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT (SELECT n FROM lim) ) SELECT me.user_id AS session_ok, (($3)::text IS NULL OR notification_category_ok(($3)::text)) AS category_ok, (SELECT json_agg(sp.category ORDER BY sp.ord) FROM notification_category_spec() sp) AS categories, json_build_object( 'notifications', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object( 'id', p.id, 'category', p.category, 'kind', p.kind, 'tone', p.tone, 'icon', p.icon, 'subject', p.subject, 'description', p.description, 'link', p.link, 'game', p.game, 'season', p.season, 'model_id', p.model_id, 'version_id', p.version_id, 'match_id', p.match_id, 'actor', p.actor, 'data', p.data, 'created_at', p.created_at, 'read_at', p.read_at) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC) FROM page p), '[]'::json), 'unread', (SELECT count(*) FROM notifications u WHERE u.user_id = me.user_id AND u.read_at IS NULL), 'next_cursor', CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM page) = (SELECT n FROM lim) THEN (SELECT (to_json(x.created_at) #>> '{}') || '|' || x.id::text FROM page x ORDER BY x.created_at ASC, x.id ASC LIMIT 1) END ) AS body FROM me
